sections.What we use it for:
The site documents `kac`, and MkDocs was chosen because it is what tool documentation uses. The site is not a corpus, so `publishing-target: mkdocs` in a corpus descriptor is a separate thing this build does not exercise.

Under MkDocs, `strict: true` in `mkdocs.yml` turned a dead link into a failed build. MkDocs reported a page the navigation does not list at INFO only, so `NavigationTests` in `kac.tests` covers that case.
sections.Status: [tol-zensical](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/7912e0bf3bf4296cc127ccd8a8fb0d558179fbae/examples/dog-fooding/tools/docs/zensical.md) builds the site instead, from the same `mkdocs.yml`. The theme this generator rendered with reaches end of life on 2026-11-05, and MkDocs 2.0 drops the plugin system. `mkdocs.yml` still builds the same site under 1.6.1, so returning to this generator is a change to `docs/requirements.txt` and to the build command.
